name: Balanced Dollar
oneLiner: bnUSD is Balanced's decentralized dollar stablecoin on ICON, minted from overcollateralized CDPs against sICX and bridged cross-chain via xCall.
collateral: Overcollateralized loans on ICON against sICX (staked ICX), with cross-chain Hub collateral support for assets bridged in via Balanced's xCall infrastructure
pegMechanism: CDP-style mint: users borrow bnUSD against eligible collateral on the ICON Hub through the Balanced Loans contract, paying a 0.2% origination fee and a 2% annualised interest charge; loans must remain above the protocol's collateral ratio or are eligible for liquidation. The same bnUSD supply circulates wrapper-free across connected chains via xCall, so cross-chain balances net back to the canonical ICON issuance.

oracleRisk.summary: Balanced bnUSD loans depend on external collateral price feeds, with public sources tying Balanced oracle integration to Band but not showing stronger failover handling.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: No direct bnUSD holder blacklist was identified, but Balanced's Stability Fund swaps USDC and USDT 1:1 for bnUSD and holds those stablecoins as collateral. That creates upstream freeze exposure under the any-reserve policy.

mintAuthority.summary: bnUSD is minted on ICON when users borrow against overcollateralized sICX (and bridged Hub) collateral through the Balanced Loans contract; the Balanced DAO governs collateral ratios, fees, and accepted collateral, with cross-chain balances circulating via xCall.

controls.label: Balanced Loans contract (CDP mint)
controls.capDescription: Mint bounded by the per-position collateral ratio against sICX/Hub collateral; 0.2% origination fee and 2% annualized interest.
controls.evidence: Users borrow bnUSD against eligible collateral on the ICON Hub via the Balanced Loans contract, with liquidation enforced below the protocol collateral ratio.

controls.label: Balanced DAO governance
controls.evidence: Balanced DAO governs collateral ratios, fees, accepted collateral, and xCall connections; it tunes parameters rather than minting directly.

review.evidence: Balanced docs describe a DAO-governed overcollateralized CDP on ICON where the Loans contract mints bnUSD against sICX and bridged Hub collateral; the same supply circulates cross-chain via xCall rather than via independent wrapper mints.
review.sourceFreeRationale: CDP mechanism and DAO governance confirmed from Balanced docs. ICON chain has no keyless EVM RPC; ICON contract state (Loans contract admin, DAO execution path) cannot be read from standard EVM tooling.
unresolvedQuestions: ICON chain has no publicly accessible keyless RPC for contract reads; cannot verify the Balanced Loans contract admin/owner on-chain. Requires ICON-native tooling (e.g. ICON node API or tracker API) to enumerate the cx88fd7df7ddff82f7cc735c871dc519838cb235bb contract admin and DAO governance execution path.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Balanced markets bnUSD as usable across many chains and describes cross-chain connectivity through xCall/IBC-style messaging. Because holder movement is part of a cross-chain DeFi liquidity system rather than issuer redemption-only rails, the route is reviewed as liquidity-route risk.

notices.title: Primary issuance lives on ICON, not yet a Pharos-supported chain
notices.message: bnUSD is minted on ICON (canonical contract cx88fd7df7ddff82f7cc735c871dc519838cb235bb) where ~95% of supply currently sits. Balanced uses its xCall infrastructure to extend the same supply to other chains, so the EVM/Injective contracts tracked here represent cross-chain wraps of the ICON-issued supply. Additional active deployments on Archway and Havah (also not Pharos-supported), and on Optimism, are visible in DefiLlama but excluded from contracts[] until those chains are wired into Pharos.

notices.title: v2 migration to Sonic in progress
notices.message: Balanced is migrating to a v2 architecture that re-anchors bnUSD issuance on Sonic. The cross-chain deployments tracked here are the v1 (ICON-Hub) bnUSD that DefiLlama indexes under id 204; the v2 bnUSD on Sonic is a separate contract not yet tracked. Expect supply distribution and the canonical issuance chain to shift over time.
